raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Upgrade the typos pre-commit hook from v1.43.5 to v1.46.1, which detects additional spelling errors not caught by v1.43.5.

**Fixed typos:**
- `elpased` → `elapsed` (vllm/envs.py, vllm/utils/gc_utils.py)
- `natually` → `naturally` (vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/modelopt.py)

**Added ignore rules for false positives:**
- `stride_bse` — variable name (B scale expert stride) in fused_moe kernels
- `writeable` — NumPy API attribute `arr.flags.writeable`
- `layrnorm` — intentionally kept to match HuggingFace model weight names (clip.py, deepencoder.py)

## Test Plan

Run typos check with the new version:

```bash
typos --force-exclude .
```

## Test Result

All checks pass with typos v1.46.1:

```
$ typos --force-exclude .
(no output — no errors)
```

---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [ ] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [ ] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [ ] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the typos pre-commit hook to version v1.46.1 and fixes several spelling errors in comments and variable names, such as correcting 'elpased' to 'elapsed' and 'natually' to 'naturally'. Additionally, it expands the typos exclusion list in pyproject.toml to include terms like 'stride_bse', 'writeable', and 'layrnorm'. I have no feedback to provide as there were no review comments.
These seem like typos we should fix, nor ignore?

Both are intentional, not bugs to fix:

- `writeable` is the correct NumPy API name (`ndarray.flags.writeable`), not a misspelling of `writable`. See https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/tests/v1/executor/test_ray_utils.py#L50-L52 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/transformers_utils/processors/isaac.py#L30.
- `layrnorm` is kept to match upstream HuggingFace CLIP model attribute names. Fixing it would break model compatibility. See the explicit comments in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/models/clip.py#L652 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/models/deepencoder.py#L628.
Ahh that's unfortunate, thanks for providing the context!
